`profile.json` is the frozen public deterministic admission vector from
[cgrd ca8783f](https://github.com/corbet-foss/cgrd/blob/ca8783f3bb114d055987fd44d86628197ecc845d/tests/vectors/admission.json).
It tests real COSE and device signatures, schema validation and pin openings.
The keys and synthetic profile are test data, not production credentials.
Upstream cgrd is LGPL-3.0-only WITH LGPL-3.0-linking-exception.
